answer: The network can give every trade a dispute window: both sides lock deposits, and either party may post a bond to challenge the deal, demanding cryptographic evidence within one epoch. Like ships tied at a jetty, the deposits sit in plain view while the tide of the challenge period runs out. No-show loses automatically, no appeal. An honest agent answers one challenge cheaply from its frozen tundra of calm records; a sybil farmer with a thousand fakes must produce valid evidence for every challenged deal, and every silent puppet forfeits its deposit.
